bug_info.bug_desc: The PMP address write guard checks the current entry's lock bit twice. It never checks whether the next entry is locked in TOR mode, even though that upper entry uses `pmpaddr[index]` as its lower bound. Software can therefore modify an address register that must be protected by the locked TOR entry above it.
bug_info.fix_hint: Keep the current entry lock check and test `pmpcfg_q[index+1].locked` for the adjacent TOR restriction when deciding whether `pmpaddr[index]` may be written.
